evidence.text:
Our roots took hold in the heart of Texas during a time when the industry's potential had yet to fully bloom. Now, over a half century later, Willow Bridge and our 6,000+ team members have grown to be one of the largest multifamily managers in the United States, with over 240,000 units under management. Plus, we’re one of the nation’s largest multifamily developers, developing over 200,000+ units over the years, with more communities on the horizon.

Founded in 1965 in Dallas, TX - Willow Bridge (formerly Lincoln Property Company’s residential division) has seen it all when it comes to residential real estate. Throughout the decades, Willow Bridge has developed over 200,000 units and today manages 200,000 units and has $3B in investment AUM.

Following Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan’s purchase of the residential division of the company, we unveil a new name and brand. Today, Willow Bridge manages over 180,000 apartment units and eyes even more growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding marketplace. With $3B in investments under management and over $1B currently under development, the sky is the limit.

Lincoln Property Company’s residential division appears on the inaugural NMHC Top 50 list as the second largest multifamily manager with 80,706 units under management and the fourth largest multifamily developer with 63,206 units owned in 1990.

LINCOLN PROPERTY COMPANY REACHES 100,000 UNITS UNDER MANAGEMENT

With a legacy spanning decades, our purposeful journey continues. Since our inception in 1965, Willow Bridge (previously known as Lincoln Property Company’s residential division) has been led and operated by visionaries who have created, managed, and stewarded exceptional residential communities all across America.

Lincoln’s residential division launched a $1.8B investment fund with Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP) and Investment Management Corporation of Ontario (IMCO). The focus of the fund is on the development and acquisition of high quality multifamily assets in top US markets.

evidence.title: Our Promise | Our Mission
evidence.text:
Willow Bridge Property Company

Whether you’re an investor looking to expand your portfolio, a team player that is looking for career growth, or a person simply looking to start a new chapter in one of our apartment homes, Willow Bridge is here to support you. Our mission is to deliver impeccable service with integrity and give you the resources you need to thrive and feel empowered. Build a partnership with us today.

We act with our entire community in mind. Investors. Clients. Employees. Residents. Everyone has a role. We create the best resident experience, providing comfort like the iconic sheltering willow tree. We enable growth, community, and exchange like the suspension bridge that stands the test of time as a symbol of human ingenuity and drive. We do it because we care about building great relationships. With the cities, towns, and communities we belong to: we’re good corporate citizens. With clients and partners: we transform the trust and resources they place with us into growth that we can all benefit from. With the people who let us into their homes: we’re the best at service.

We are accountable for ensuring our neighbors are happy in their homes and take ownership of any problems that may arise.

Founded in 1965 in Dallas, TX - Willow Bridge (formerly Lincoln Property Company’s residential division) has seen it all when it comes to residential real estate. Throughout the decades, Willow Bridge has developed over 200,000 units and today manages 200,000 units and has $3B in investment AUM.

Following Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan’s purchase of the residential division of the company, we unveil a new name and brand. Today, Willow Bridge manages over 180,000 apartment units and eyes even more growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding marketplace. With $3B in investments under management and over $1B currently under development, the sky is the limit.

Lincoln Property Company’s residential division appears on the inaugural NMHC Top 50 list as the second largest multifamily manager with 80,706 units under management and the fourth largest multifamily developer with 63,206 units owned in 1990.

LINCOLN PROPERTY COMPANY REACHES 100,000 UNITS UNDER MANAGEMENT

With a legacy spanning decades, our purposeful journey continues. Since our inception in 1965, Willow Bridge (previously known as Lincoln Property Company’s residential division) has been led and operated by visionaries who have created, managed, and stewarded exceptional residential communities all across America.

Lincoln’s residential division launched a $1.8B investment fund with Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP) and Investment Management Corporation of Ontario (IMCO). The focus of the fund is on the development and acquisition of high quality multifamily assets in top US markets.

Lincoln’s residential division tops 100,000 multifamily units under management in 1997, according to the National Multifamily Housing Council (NMHC) as the third largest management company in the United States. Lincoln Property Company’s residential division (now Willow Bridge) has ranked on the NMHC 50 list every year since its debut in 1989.

evidence.title: Asset Living | Multifamily Property Management
evidence.text:
2016 No task is too large or too complicated for team Asset. After being awarded management of the CCG Portfolio, our team seamlessly transitioned 74 properties inclusive of 42,000 beds over a 45-day period.

2011 Team Asset is recognized as an industry leader in property management ranked as No. 1 on SHB’s Top Managers List, No. 34 on NMHC’s Top Managers List, and ending the year with 34,000 units.

Proudly managing over 2,700 communities nationwide.

Our unwavering commitment to excellence has secured us the No. 2 spot on NMHC’s Top 50 Manager List for multifamily living.

We deliver comprehensive property management services across a diverse range of communities.

2020 Broadened our affordable property management portfolio while simultaneously growing our multi-family presence in the Southwest following the acquisition of Alpha Barnes Real Estate Services and Shelton Residential.

The Charles, a multifamily community in Destin, FL, faced early lease-up challenges due to ongoing construction delays and non-operational amenities during its first year. To maintain resident satisfaction and protect the property’s online reputation, the Asset Living team implemented proactive communication strategies, a Virtual Leasing Concierge, and a strong lineup of community engagement initiatives. These efforts helped foster a boutique-style living experience, supported by consistent resident touchpoints and timely service delivery. With an average of 50 attendees per resident event and a sub-24-hour work order completion rate, The Charles successfully built a positive, service-driven community culture amid a difficult start.

“It’s hard to narrow down just one favorite memory as I had no idea the opportunities being an Asset Ambassador would provide me over the last few years. However, I am currently most proud of my 2023 Property Manager of the Year award with the First Coast Apartment Association in Jacksonville, FL. This award was more of a team award because I would not have been able to hit all my goals without them.”

sources.title: Asset Living | Multifamily Property Management
sources.excerpt:
2016 No task is too large or too complicated for team Asset. After being awarded management of the CCG Portfolio, our team seamlessly transitioned 74 properties inclusive of 42,000 beds over a 45-day period.

2011 Team Asset is recognized as an industry leader in property management ranked as No. 1 on SHB’s Top Managers List, No. 34 on NMHC’s Top Managers List, and ending the year with 34,000 units.

Proudly managing over 2,700 communities nationwide.

Our unwavering commitment to excellence has secured us the No. 2 spot on NMHC’s Top 50 Manager List for multifamily living.

We deliver comprehensive property management services across a diverse range of communities.

2020 Broadened our affordable property management portfolio while simultaneously growing our multi-family presence in the Southwest following the acquisition of Alpha Barnes Real Estate Services and Shelton Residential.

The Charles, a multifamily community in Destin, FL, faced early lease-up challenges due to ongoing construction delays and non-operational amenities during its first year. To maintain resident satisfaction and protect the property’s online reputation, the Asset Living team implemented proactive communication strategies, a Virtual Leasing Concierge, and a strong lineup of community engagement initiatives. These efforts helped foster a boutique-style living experience, supported by consistent resident touchpoints and timely service delivery. With an average of 50 attendees per resident event and a sub-24-hour work order completion rate, The Charles successfully built a positive, service-driven community culture amid a difficult start.

“It’s hard to narrow down just one favorite memory as I had no idea the opportunities being an Asset Ambassador would provide me over the last few years. However, I am currently most proud of my 2023 Property Manager of the Year award with the First Coast Apartment Association in Jacksonville, FL. This award was more of a team award because I would not have been able to hit all my goals without them.”

UDR is a leading multifamily REIT that delivers strong shareholder returns through innovation, disciplined capital allocation, and a commitment to valuing its employees. evidence.title: Portfolio Overview | UDR Apartment Communities
evidence.text:
UDR’s portfolio strategy is driven by a commitment to growth, innovation, and sustainability. By strategically investing in new developments, acquisitions, and redevelopments, the Company creates long-term value while enhancing operational efficiency. This approach integrates cutting-edge technology, market insights, and sustainable practices to deliver high-quality living experiences that drive meaningful impact for residents, investors, and communities.

UDR designs and develops highly functional apartment communities that appeal to a variety of demographics. By utilizing in-depth market analysis, focusing on the customers’ needs, and giving careful consideration to environmental impact, UDR delivers best in class communities that enhance its portfolio and provide long-term value throughout the lifecycle of each development project.

With keen attention to market and submarket dynamics, UDR identifies apartment communities that offer the opportunity to improve property-level cash flow. UDR creates value by improving resident satisfaction and enhancing operating efficiencies. The UDR Acquisition Team has a top-tier reputation within the industry and a demonstrated track record of success.

A strategic approach to uncovering and unlocking value within well-located apartment communities across growing markets, the Redevelopment Program targets underperforming or overlooked assets with strong potential—applying capital improvements and rebranding strategies that enhance property performance, reposition assets in their markets, and drive NOI and long-term returns. Design upgrades are aligned with market demand, with a consistent focus on elevating the resident experience and ensuring operational excellence.

Developing Innovative Communities for Tomorrow

I've had a great experience living at this apartment complex. The property is well-maintained, clean, and provides a comfortable place to call home. The management team is professional, responsive, and genuinely cares about ... READ MORE

Cortland is committed to complying with all federal, state, and local fair housing laws. We will not discriminate in the leasing or management of any of our communities on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, handicap, familial status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other class protected by applicable law.

Investors Sustainability Community Management

As a first-time renter, I was nervous and unsure of what to expect, but the leasing team made the process so easy. A special thank you to the gals in the office—Krystal, Sharon, and Maryssa—for their patience, guidance, and ... READ MORE

Get an inside look at some of our featured communities.

At Cortland, we’ve got this wild, out-there idea of putting our residents first. We know. Crazy, right? But we’re not your normal apartment company, and we don’t think our residents should settle for a normal apartment living experience. That’s why we look for ways to put our residents front and center. Whether we’re helping you with your fitness journey, inspiring you through our thoughtful interior design, or just giving you one less thing to worry about with our services and amenities, we’ve got your back. Because if we’ve got your back, then where you are is exactly front and center.

sources.title: Cortland | Next-Level Apartment Living
sources.excerpt:
I've had a great experience living at this apartment complex. The property is well-maintained, clean, and provides a comfortable place to call home. The management team is professional, responsive, and genuinely cares about ... READ MORE

Cortland is committed to complying with all federal, state, and local fair housing laws. We will not discriminate in the leasing or management of any of our communities on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, handicap, familial status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other class protected by applicable law.

Investors Sustainability Community Management

As a first-time renter, I was nervous and unsure of what to expect, but the leasing team made the process so easy. A special thank you to the gals in the office—Krystal, Sharon, and Maryssa—for their patience, guidance, and ... READ MORE

Get an inside look at some of our featured communities.

At Cortland, we’ve got this wild, out-there idea of putting our residents first. We know. Crazy, right? But we’re not your normal apartment company, and we don’t think our residents should settle for a normal apartment living experience. That’s why we look for ways to put our residents front and center. Whether we’re helping you with your fitness journey, inspiring you through our thoughtful interior design, or just giving you one less thing to worry about with our services and amenities, we’ve got your back. Because if we’ve got your back, then where you are is exactly front and center.

evidence.title: HHHunt Awards & Recognition • Excellence in Living, Service & Community
evidence.text:
Thanks to our dedicated team of professionals, our award-winning apartment living, new construction homes and new home communities demonstrate our commitment to live our vision to improve the world and how people live.

Our award-winning apartment home communities are built with the goal to hold onto them for life. Recognized by local and national apartment associations, we’ve earned awards for community outreach, team excellence and customer service—including J Turner’s 2024 Elite 1% ORA Ranking and a #5 national ranking for resident satisfaction. Winning top honors for our communities, clubhouses, amenities and service shows how we strive to deliver on our Brand Promises every day!

Careful planning, innovative designs, amenities and lifestyle events are trademarks of HHHunt Communities. HHHunt Communities was awarded Community of the Year in 2025 and Condominium Community of the Year in 2024 for Wescott in Midlothian, VA. The Pointe at Twin Hickory in Glen Allen, VA, was also awarded The 2025 Community of the Year. We’ve also been recognized with top honors for our community websites, amenities and more!

evidence.text:
The recognition highlights S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co.’s continued growth and strength as a multifamily management leader. With a portfolio of more than 32,000 apartment homes managed throughout the Mid-Atlantic and Southeast, the company has built a reputation for operational excellence, exceptional resident experiences, and long-term value creation for property owners.

Who We Are |&nbsp Newsroom |&nbsp S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. Ranked No. 34 Among the Nation’s Top Multifamily Property Management Companies

S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. Ranked No. 34 Among the Nation’s Top Multifamily Property Management Companies

NORFOLK, VA (August 2026) – S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. is proud to announce that it has been ranked No. 34 nationally in Multi-Housing News’ 2026 ranking of the Top Multifamily Property Management Companies, placing the firm among the largest and most respected multifamily management organizations in the United States. The annual ranking recognizes the country’s leading property management companies based on a range of factors, including units under management, portfolio performance, growth, and market presence.

“The steady growth of our portfolio is due largely to the loyalty and trust of our many long-term clients, as well as our extraordinary corporate, regional, and onsite employees,” said Steve Boyce, Senior Vice President/Co-Director of Operations.

Published by Multi-Housing News, the 2026 ranking evaluated 65 of the nation’s leading multifamily management firms. Collectively, these companies manage more than 4.1 million apartment units across approximately 18,800 communities nationwide, demonstrating the scale and competitiveness of the industry’s top performers.

“Being named among the top multifamily property management companies in the nation is a tremendous honor and a reflection of the dedication of our associates across every market we serve,” said Aaron Wyatt, Senior Vice President/Co-Director of Operations. “For more than a century, our company has remained committed to delivering outstanding service, fostering vibrant communities, and helping our clients achieve their investment goals. This recognition underscores the strength of our team and the trust our residents and ownership partners place in us every day.”

evidence.title: Homes for Rent in North Carolina / Acorn & Oak
evidence.text:
My wife and I moved to the area and decided to rent from Acorn and Oak Property Management because of the good reviews online. They did not disappoint. Whenever we had any trouble with our rental property, Acorn and Oak always sent someone out promptly to check out the problem. The portal is very easy to use the the staff are great to interact with (we worked with Laurie and Nicole and they were super). I would highly recommend choosing to rent from Acorn and Oak.

Acorn + Oak managed our rental property while we lived out-of-state. We had an excellent experience with them. We were kept informed of issues (e.g., leaky washer, new renter applications, etc.), but always had faith that everything was professionally and efficiently handled. They also have a user-friendly online portal where you can access monthly reports, tax documents, etc. We worked with Daniel Woodward, and he was phenomenal--quick, transparent communication and always on top of it. We cannot say enough good things about working with Acorn + Oak if you are looking to rent property!

The acorn and the oak have long been symbols of growth, strength, and prosperity. Legend has it that an oak branch or acorn placed inside a living space helps protect the home and its occupants. It is in this spirit that Acorn + Oak Property Management planted our own roots in North Carolina in 2013. Today we manage a growing roster of single-family homes and small multi-unit complexes throughout Durham, Raleigh, Chapel Hill and the surrounding cities.

We had reached out to a few different property management companies before our friends helped us find Acorn + Oak. When you are renting your home you want it to be in good hands and with people who make you feel heard. Ariel from Acorn + Oak listened and respected what was important to us--never pressuring us into anything and always valuing our opinion. They have been great at communicating, getting the home ready quickly, finding multiple quotes, and so impressively always one step ahead and on top of everything. Very grateful to be working with this company!

evidence.title: Superior Property Management in NC: Acorn & Oak
evidence.text:
Since our launch in 2013, Acorn + Oak has been fortunate enough to grow from zero to over 2,200 units under management. Our success has everything to do with the quality of service we're dedicated to providing and by following the Golden Rule - treating others how we'd like to be treated.

Whether you’re being relocated to Tokyo or live right around the corner from your rental property, Acorn + Oak can help. We work with all types of property owners: Investment groups, solo real estate investors, the homeowner whose job is moving them out of state next week, and even the “reluctant landlord” whose home has been up for sale for 6 months. Whatever your background, wherever you live, we’ll look after your property as if it was our own.

We're much more than status quo. Acorn + Oak was created to be a different kind of property management company. One that valued relationships with both our clients and tenants, refused to cut corners, and dedicated everyday to delivering customer service that knocks your socks off.

We're committed to providing our tenants with an excellent experience which produces happier residents, longer tenancies, and better care of the homes we manage. Everybody wins.

Acorn + Oak was created to be a different kind of property management company. One that valued relationships with both our clients and tenants, refused to cut corners, and dedicated everyday to delivering customer service that knocks your socks off.

Broker led property tours on every home we manage

Headache-free maintenance management and access to our trusted vendors

Convenient account access 24 hours a day through your Owner Portal

sources.title: Homes for Rent in North Carolina / Acorn & Oak
sources.excerpt:
My wife and I moved to the area and decided to rent from Acorn and Oak Property Management because of the good reviews online. They did not disappoint. Whenever we had any trouble with our rental property, Acorn and Oak always sent someone out promptly to check out the problem. The portal is very easy to use the the staff are great to interact with (we worked with Laurie and Nicole and they were super). I would highly recommend choosing to rent from Acorn and Oak.

Acorn + Oak managed our rental property while we lived out-of-state. We had an excellent experience with them. We were kept informed of issues (e.g., leaky washer, new renter applications, etc.), but always had faith that everything was professionally and efficiently handled. They also have a user-friendly online portal where you can access monthly reports, tax documents, etc. We worked with Daniel Woodward, and he was phenomenal--quick, transparent communication and always on top of it. We cannot say enough good things about working with Acorn + Oak if you are looking to rent property!

The acorn and the oak have long been symbols of growth, strength, and prosperity. Legend has it that an oak branch or acorn placed inside a living space helps protect the home and its occupants. It is in this spirit that Acorn + Oak Property Management planted our own roots in North Carolina in 2013. Today we manage a growing roster of single-family homes and small multi-unit complexes throughout Durham, Raleigh, Chapel Hill and the surrounding cities.

We had reached out to a few different property management companies before our friends helped us find Acorn + Oak. When you are renting your home you want it to be in good hands and with people who make you feel heard. Ariel from Acorn + Oak listened and respected what was important to us--never pressuring us into anything and always valuing our opinion. They have been great at communicating, getting the home ready quickly, finding multiple quotes, and so impressively always one step ahead and on top of everything. Very grateful to be working with this company!

sources.title: Superior Property Management in NC: Acorn & Oak
sources.excerpt:
Since our launch in 2013, Acorn + Oak has been fortunate enough to grow from zero to over 2,200 units under management. Our success has everything to do with the quality of service we're dedicated to providing and by following the Golden Rule - treating others how we'd like to be treated.

Whether you’re being relocated to Tokyo or live right around the corner from your rental property, Acorn + Oak can help. We work with all types of property owners: Investment groups, solo real estate investors, the homeowner whose job is moving them out of state next week, and even the “reluctant landlord” whose home has been up for sale for 6 months. Whatever your background, wherever you live, we’ll look after your property as if it was our own.

We're much more than status quo. Acorn + Oak was created to be a different kind of property management company. One that valued relationships with both our clients and tenants, refused to cut corners, and dedicated everyday to delivering customer service that knocks your socks off.

We're committed to providing our tenants with an excellent experience which produces happier residents, longer tenancies, and better care of the homes we manage. Everybody wins.

Acorn + Oak was created to be a different kind of property management company. One that valued relationships with both our clients and tenants, refused to cut corners, and dedicated everyday to delivering customer service that knocks your socks off.

Broker led property tours on every home we manage

Headache-free maintenance management and access to our trusted vendors

Convenient account access 24 hours a day through your Owner Portal

Detailed accounting and financial services

I can wholeheartedly endorse Lynlee and the A&O team.

evidence.text:
At this time, Parkwood Property Management, Inc. manages approximately 350 units throughout Pierce County; serving local, stateside and out-of-country clients. Our rental units range in price from $450 – $3200 per month, allowing us to serve a wide variety of rental property customers.

Effective management of rental properties by development and implementation of individaul management programs enhancing each property’s strengths to ensure achievement of the propery owners’ objectives.

Since its inception in 1988, Parkwood Property Management, Inc. has successfully managed rental property throughout Pierce County. Strict Tenant Screening policies, strong communication with tenants and owners, and hand on management practices are tools used to achieve that goal.

Parkwood Property Management, Inc. began as a division on Parkwood Realty, Better Homes & Gardens in early 1988. In March 1993, Ms. Bethel purchased the company. As an owner-operated business, we have the advantage of giving our clients the personal attention they deserve. Our staff realized that each client and property has individual concerns and tailors its management programs to meet those needs.

evidence.title: San Francisco Property Management - Gordon Property Management
evidence.text:
Renting out property in San Francisco is more complex than ever. With new laws, new market trends, and new risk, the leasing and management process requires an experienced, professional property management team.

Gordon Property Management has managed single family homes and multi-unit residential apartment buildings in San Francisco since 1987. We’re dedicated to providing property management San Francisco owners and tenants trust.

From leasing to management to maintenance, the talented team at Gordon Property Management protects the condition, value, and profitability of your investments. You deserve better peace of mind.

Our San Francisco property management leadership extends to understanding the numerous local, state, and federal laws which affect the rental housing industry.

How can tenant credit scores help owners select and place qualified residents in their San Francisco properties? This is a competitive, highly regulated rental market, and tenant credit scores are an important metric. In fact, among all the variables property owners...

All our employees have completed the San Francisco’s Apartment Association CCRM courses, which covers San Francisco’s Rent Control Ordinance, fair housing laws, and essential landlord/tenant best practices. The San Francisco Rent Control Ordinance has unfortunately turned the landlord/tenant relationship into something that’s potentially adversarial. It doesn’t have to be that way, and while some tenants can be a challenge – we believe in treating everyone fairly and consistently so your experience as a landlord is positive and profitable.

Our high standards, industry leadership and excellent customer service set us apart from other property management companies.

Working with San Francisco owners in The Mission District, The Marina, Mission Bay, Pacific Heights, Noe Valley + surrounding areas.

San Francisco is a unique rental market. Landlords need to navigate the San Francisco Rent Control Ordinance, new fair housing regulations, and a vast range in rental prices. Your success depends on expert property management. We perform at a higher level than other companies.

At Gordon Property Management, we are leasing agents and property managers. We are maintenance professionals and administrative specialists. We are committed to making your experience better.

Extraordinary San Francisco Property Management

Property management is our only business. We lease homes and apartments, we manage properties, and we consult with owners on how to increase the returns on their investments. You can expect our team to be professional, responsive, and proactive. We bring innovative thinking to every system, and we are constantly improving processes to make them more efficient.

Since 1987, we have been successfully providing San Francisco property management for investors like you. We know that your property is unique and your goals are significant. The management plan we craft for you will reflect who you are, what you want, and why you’re here.

At Gordon Property Management, we strive to find a balance between serving our property owner clients, and our tenants who need high quality housing. Our primary responsibility is to the property owners we work with, and we know from experience that providing our tenants with reliable service benefits our owners as well as our tenants. Responsiveness to maintenance leads to lower turnover rates and respectful communication brings us better relationships.

As you look for San Francisco property management services, choose an expert who can protect your asset and ensure a healthy return on your investment.

Nanette Barr Property Manager DRE License #01929355

Smart investors know that hiring a professional property management company to lease, manage, and maintain their rental investments makes financial and practical sense. But, you have to choose the right company. You have to select a property management partner who understands your unique investment goals and your property’s place in the market.

San Francisco Property Management Services

Gordon Property Management leads the local San Francisco management industry.

Property Management Services Owners and Investors Trust

Our marketing is targeted and effective because the San Francisco property management market is competitive. We use professional photographers, online advertising, our own website, and our connections within the San Francisco community to attract potential tenants.

We screen for credit, criminal, and eviction backgrounds, and talk to former landlords to ensure we only hand over the keys to tenants who follow the terms of the lease and take good care of a home. Our thoroughness sets us apart from other San Francisco property management companies.

What Can You Expect When You Work with Gordon Property Management?

Every investment property is unique. We create a custom San Francisco property management plan for your investment, whether it’s a single unit or a portfolio of buildings. Count on us for high quality leasing, management, and maintenance services that are legally compliant and designed to earn you more in rent and ROI.

Smart investors know that hiring a professional property management company to lease, manage, and maintain their rental investments makes financial and practical sense. But, you have to choose the right company. You have to select a property management partner who understands your unique investment goals and your property’s place in the market.

San Francisco Property Management Services

Gordon Property Management leads the local San Francisco management industry.

Property Management Services Owners and Investors Trust

Our marketing is targeted and effective because the San Francisco property management market is competitive. We use professional photographers, online advertising, our own website, and our connections within the San Francisco community to attract potential tenants.

We screen for credit, criminal, and eviction backgrounds, and talk to former landlords to ensure we only hand over the keys to tenants who follow the terms of the lease and take good care of a home. Our thoroughness sets us apart from other San Francisco property management companies.

What Can You Expect When You Work with Gordon Property Management?

Renting out property in San Francisco is more complex than ever. With new laws, new market trends, and new risk, the leasing and management process requires an experienced, professional property management team.

Gordon Property Management has managed single family homes and multi-unit residential apartment buildings in San Francisco since 1987. We’re dedicated to providing property management San Francisco owners and tenants trust.

From leasing to management to maintenance, the talented team at Gordon Property Management protects the condition, value, and profitability of your investments. You deserve better peace of mind.

Our San Francisco property management leadership extends to understanding the numerous local, state, and federal laws which affect the rental housing industry.

How can tenant credit scores help owners select and place qualified residents in their San Francisco properties? This is a competitive, highly regulated rental market, and tenant credit scores are an important metric. In fact, among all the variables property owners...

All our employees have completed the San Francisco’s Apartment Association CCRM courses, which covers San Francisco’s Rent Control Ordinance, fair housing laws, and essential landlord/tenant best practices. The San Francisco Rent Control Ordinance has unfortunately turned the landlord/tenant relationship into something that’s potentially adversarial. It doesn’t have to be that way, and while some tenants can be a challenge – we believe in treating everyone fairly and consistently so your experience as a landlord is positive and profitable.

Our high standards, industry leadership and excellent customer service set us apart from other property management companies.

Working with San Francisco owners in The Mission District, The Marina, Mission Bay, Pacific Heights, Noe Valley + surrounding areas.

sources.title: About Us | Gordon Property Management in San Francisco
sources.quote:
San Francisco is a unique rental market. Landlords need to navigate the San Francisco Rent Control Ordinance, new fair housing regulations, and a vast range in rental prices. Your success depends on expert property management. We perform at a higher level than other companies.

At Gordon Property Management, we are leasing agents and property managers. We are maintenance professionals and administrative specialists. We are committed to making your experience better.

Extraordinary San Francisco Property Management

Property management is our only business. We lease homes and apartments, we manage properties, and we consult with owners on how to increase the returns on their investments. You can expect our team to be professional, responsive, and proactive. We bring innovative thinking to every system, and we are constantly improving processes to make them more efficient.

Since 1987, we have been successfully providing San Francisco property management for investors like you. We know that your property is unique and your goals are significant. The management plan we craft for you will reflect who you are, what you want, and why you’re here.

At Gordon Property Management, we strive to find a balance between serving our property owner clients, and our tenants who need high quality housing. Our primary responsibility is to the property owners we work with, and we know from experience that providing our tenants with reliable service benefits our owners as well as our tenants. Responsiveness to maintenance leads to lower turnover rates and respectful communication brings us better relationships.

As you look for San Francisco property management services, choose an expert who can protect your asset and ensure a healthy return on your investment.

Nanette Barr Property Manager DRE License #01929355

We use the San Francisco Apartment Association’s Residential Tenancy Agreement, which is what every landlord in San Francisco should be using.

sources.excerpt:
With 20+ years of experience and impressive stats like a 98.75% on-time payment rate, Peabody Residential provides full-service Property Management for single-family homes. We are proud to be recognized as one of the most award-winning and best-reviewed property management companies in Northern Virginia and DC. Our team of experts is ready to help you with any questions you have.

At Peabody Residential, we prioritize efficient financial management to ensure your rental property is a profitable investment. Our services include timely rent collection through secure online payment systems, making it easy for tenants to pay on time and for owners to receive prompt disbursements.

At Peabody Residential, we’re more than just a property management company—we’re a dedicated team committed to creating and nurturing a sense of family for both our clients and our residents. We’ve assembled a talented, passionate group of professionals from around the world, all of whom share a commitment to helping others achieve their property goals.

Our clients have trusted us to manage their homes and investments, knowing we bring heart and a deep sense of responsibility to each property. Over the years, we’ve helped over 1,500 clients turn their properties into thriving investments, providing not just profitable returns but quality housing for the communities we serve. For us, that’s the true reward: supporting our clients’ financial growth while helping people find a place they’re proud to call home.

Peabody Residential is proud to be recognized as one of the most award-winning and best-reviewed property management companies in Northern Virginia and DC. Our team lead has even trained other property managers in the industry, sharing our best practices to raise the standard for everyone.

Work with the unparalleled expertise of our award-winning, certified rental management team and experience a level of service that sets us apart in the marketplace.

If you choose to work with us, you will be working with a residential property management company that offers education and training to REALTORS® and Residental Real Estate Brokerages of more than 7,000 Agents associated with Keller William, Berkshire Hathaway, Rem/Max, Coldwell Banker, Weichert, and National Realty, in our service area. Learn how we are creating a higher standard among real estate rental professional at NORAP.

Book a Free Property Management Consultation Rentals 703-436-6964

Our team also handles insurance requirements, ensuring compliance and safeguarding your assets.

Peabody Residential

Work with the unparalleled expertise of our award-winning, certified rental management team and experience a level of service that sets us apart in the marketplace.

We manage our clients' properties just like we manage our own. Our property management style is the most transparent in Reston Virginia, with the most efficient systems in place to deliver the highest level of service. As a client, you will experience online access to detailed financials and statements, communication tracking, and direct deposits of your rental funds.

We provide a 60-day notice prior to lease expiration and handle all lease renewals and negotiations between the tenant and property owners. With your approval of the rental price, we will re-lease the property. We can also provide an up-to-date rental market analysis if needed. This comprehensive approach to property management ensures a high lease renewal rate and consistent income for your investment.

Re-Lease Property (with Owner/Landlord approval of rental price and re-lease)

Why Hire Us To Manage Your Rental Property in VA?

When something is happening at your property that needs attention, you will be updated in real time on the maintenance dispatching. We also verify rental history and ensure timely monthly management reports.

Book a Free Property Management Consultation Rentals 703-436-6964

Winner of the Best of Reston Property Management Award 12 consecutive years

Our team manages late rent notices, NSF payments, and coordinates the eviction process when necessary.

We manage a limited property portfolio of $150 Million in assets annually while maintaining our status as the highest-certified and most award-winning property management company in Northern Virginia and D.C.

sources.title: Property Management Services Richmond VA | Real Property Management Richmond Metro
sources.quote:
Real Property Management’s professional services include ongoing communication, comprehensive marketing, and advertising, thorough tenant screening and selection, full-service leasing, timely rent collection, regular property reviews, cost-effective and reliable maintenance, strict and compliant evictions, and comprehensive accounting.

Real Property Management makes every effort to keep you informed about your property. A secure online account provided by our team keeps you updated on property activity, including vacancies, leasing, maintenance, property reviews and financial reports. Whether you live a few blocks from your rental property or hundreds of miles away, you can monitor the activity of your property from the convenience of your computer, 24 hours a day anywhere in the world.

Each day that your property is vacant is money out of your pocket. Professional management costs are easily offset by shorter vacancy times. We spend thousands of dollars every month advertising our vacancies to get them filled – faster. Your property is advertised on high-traffic rental and classified websites. A professional “For Rent” yard sign adds exposure to capture drive-by prospective tenants. Our experienced leasing agents respond promptly to inquiries and advise prospective tenants on details about the property, and show your home in the best possible light.

Placing the wrong tenant can quickly cost you what you may save by managing a property yourself. Every tenant application is evaluated based on credit, background, employment verification and residency/rental history. Our thorough screening complies with all applicable laws, including Fair Housing and Fair Credit Reporting Act.

Your leasing agent manages the lease signing with the approved tenant, using our professionally prepared lease, and ensures that all proper contracts are executed correctly. At the same time, rents, deposits and any fees are collected in accordance with local legal and financial regulations, and recorded to your online account. We also provide professional tenant education at lease signing.

Maintenance is a necessary expense in owning a rental property, and the return on your investment can be significantly impacted without timely, cost-effective repairs and upkeep. When handled by us, you’ll save time and money and ensure repairs are completed in a professional manner, by trustworthy maintenance personnel.

Our goal is to maximize your income and minimize your expenses. To keep track of your income and expenses we use a centralized accounting system. This all-inclusive accounting and reporting system, backed with itemized statements and tax documentation, keeps all your property management financial information organized in one place.

Real Property Management Richmond Metro provides each property owner client a password-protected online account for easy access to financial reports any time you need.

MRI ENGAGE · MULTIFAMILY PROPERTY MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE

Rigid software forces multifamily organizations to adapt to it. Ours adapts to you, built on real estate expertise first. AI is built in, not bolted on, connecting leasing, resident engagement, accounting, property management, and intelligence in one ecosystem.

MRI Engage is considered a end-to-end leasing solution for multifamily operators and investors. The platform serves the whole renter journey, from first search to signed lease to renewal.

evidence.text:
Rentec Direct is ideal for any landlord or property manager who manages residential or commercial properties. Although Rentec Direct includes all major features and functionality available in other software options, Rentec Direct purposefully maintains a lower price point than many competitors because Rentec Direct believes that all landlords and property managers should have access to the best software available regardless of their portfolio size. Rentec Direct is able to accomplish this because we are wholly owned, debt free, and as such do not have revenue requirements from investors. Our roots started with smaller landlords who generally cannot afford the premium prices and minimums found elsewhere and we're committed to all of our customers regardless of size. Rentec Direct works extremely well for both the startup DIY landlord as well as the professional property manager actively growing their portfolio into many thousands of units.

Highest-ranked software by thousands of landlords and property managers.

All the tools for landlords to easily manage properties and tenants

A complete management solution for professional property managers

Rentec Direct property management software gives you...

Create your own custom rentals website for tenants to discover vacancies and attract owners to your business online.

Securely store and share important files such as lease agreements, photos, and other documents with your renters and owners.

Owner Property Management Group of Oregon

evidence.title: Company Profile | Rentec Direct
evidence.text:
Rentec Direct is 100% self-funded, 100% debt-free, and we grow 100% organically. The hip term for this is called "bootstrapping" and we think companies that can grow on their own merits are pretty darn exciting. We began this way in 2007 and now over 16,000 property managers use Rentec Direct to manage over 700,000 units.

Rentec Pro, loaded with super cool features for landlords like online rental payments and tenant screening, was born a couple years later. Rentec Pro was so popular among landlords that we started getting heavy interest from property managers who wanted access to these same cool features that landlords had access to. We complied by adding Rentec PM which included nifty features like trust accounting to support the small-mid size property management community.

Rentec Direct provides award-winning customer service and is ranked as the #1 software option for landlords and property managers for customer service. Rentec Direct's customer service is all done in the USA by well-trained staff familiar with the property management industry. You can view real time unsolicited customer reviews on the Rentec Direct Reviews page.

Over 16,000 landlords and property managers use Rentec Direct to manage more than 700,000 rental units, representing over $200 billion in real estate assets. Rentec Direct is the third-largest software provider in the mid-size property management market.

Rentec Direct is built for landlords and property managers with anywhere from a single rental up to a couple thousand units. Rentec Pro is designed for landlords managing their own properties, and Rentec PM adds trust accounting and owner tools for property management companies. Enterprise operators with tens of thousands of units are better served by enterprise-focused platforms; our focus is on the small and mid-size market.

No. Rentec Direct has been independently owned and operated since its founding in 2007. While many competing platforms have been acquired, merged, or rolled up by investment groups, Rentec Direct remains the same independent, self-funded company it has always been.

evidence.title: Company Profile | Rentec Direct
evidence.text:
In 2007 our founder was managing his rentals the old fashioned way using pen, paper, spreadsheets, and his memory of who owes rent and which fridge needs replacing and which pipes were leaking. This worked great for the first few rentals, but quickly became a mess of receipts, poor record keeping, a failure to know who's rent is late, and forgetting what maintenance needed to be done when and where. Sound familiar?

So one very early morning in March of 2007, Rentec Direct started sprouting to life. One early morning after another (as Nathan also had a day job) he went to work creating a fully featured property management software application. About fourteen thousand gallons of coffee later, a free application was available to all landlords world-wide called Rentec Direct.

“For multifamily operators, HappyCo’s mobile-first design and pre-built regional templates mean most portfolios see full adoption within weeks—not months.”

evidence.title: HappyCo Brings Voice-Powered Field Intelligence to Multifamily Maintenance Operations
evidence.text:
Using HappyCo’s integrated suite of centralized maintenance solutions and services, Blanton Turner has cut unit turns from 12-14 days to 5.7 on average, with each technician now managing 150-175 units. These gains – echoed by customers like Anchor NW Property Group – break through industry benchmarks, with other operators seeing up to 60% after-hour call deflection.

What results have multifamily operators achieved using HappyCo's AI-powered maintenance platform? Operators using HappyCo's integrated maintenance solutions have achieved measurable results including: unit turn times reduced from 12-14 days to 5.7 days average (Blanton Turner), technicians managing 150-175 units each (up from industry average), and up to 60% after-hour call deflection across customer portfolios.

Serving over 50,000 multifamily property leaders across 5.5 million units, HappyCo integrates with major property management systems, including Yardi, MRI Software, RealPage, Entrata, and ResMan. Its open API marketplace enables single-click access to a growing network of prop-tech partners.

HappyCo Brings Voice-Powered Field Intelligence to Multifamily Maintenance Operations

San Diego CA – November 13, 2025 – HappyCo, a leading provider of maintenance operations software for the multifamily real estate sector, today debuted Voice Assist – AI-powered voice capture that transforms field observations into automated workflows and predictive intelligence. ‍

“Maintenance data doesn’t stop at the work order,” said Dan Regan, Director of Integrated Operations at Mark-Taylor Residential. “Completion notes are critical for us to assess service quality and identify whether issues stem from technician performance or equipment failure. That visibility drives our preventive maintenance strategy. HappyCo captures consistent documentation that reveals patterns for smarter capital planning.”

How much can maintenance documentation cost multifamily operators? Poor maintenance documentation increases unplanned repair costs by up to 40%. When completion notes are inconsistent or missing, operators lose visibility into recurring issues, can't benchmark performance, and miss early warning signs of equipment failure - leading to reactive spending and higher operational costs.

sources.excerpt:
Mr. Weger provides consulting services to real estate and other companies. Prior to that, Mr. Weger served as chief financial officer of Focus Brands Inc., the franchisor and operator of restaurants and cafes in the United States, Puerto Rico and 63 foreign countries, from 2014 to 2016. From 2012 to 2014, Mr. Weger served as chief financial officer of Outrigger Enterprises Group, a privately-held leisure lodging and hospitality company. From 1998 to 2011, Mr. Weger served as chief financial officer, executive vice president and treasurer of LaSalle Hotel Properties (NYSE: LHO), a real estate investment trust focused on the acquisition, ownership, redevelopment and leasing of primarily upscale and luxury full-service hotels. In addition, Mr. Weger served as secretary of LaSalle Hotel Properties from 1999 to 2011. Mr. Weger was responsible for all of the company’s financial, accounting, human resources and information technology activities. Prior to joining LaSalle Hotel Properties, Mr. Weger served as vice president and treasurer for La Quinta Inns, Inc. where he was responsible for all financing activities. From 1992 until 1997, Mr. Weger served in various management roles with Harrah’s Entertainment, Inc. where he was responsible for strategic planning, mergers and acquisitions and project financing. Mr. Weger holds a Bachelor of Science degree from the University of Southern Mississippi and a Master of Business Administration degree from the University of Chicago.

Since 2016, and from 1995 to 2001, Mr. Jacoby has served as executive vice president and chief financial officer of Leggat McCall Properties, LLC, a real estate development company. From 2013 to 2016, Mr. Jacoby served as an independent consultant providing real estate finance, development and disposition related services. From 2008 to 2013, he served as president of Kensington Investment Company, Inc., the wealth management office for a family that owns travel-related businesses and passenger ships and makes investments in real estate, private equity and venture capital. In addition, in 2012, Mr. Jacoby served as the chief financial officer of Grand Circle Corporation, an affiliate of Kensington Investment Company, Inc. From 2001 to 2008, Mr. Jacoby served as the senior vice president and chief financial officer for GID Investment Advisers LLC, a family wealth management office whose primary focus is developing, acquiring and managing apartment communities, suburban office properties and flex industrial business parks throughout the United States for its own account and for joint ventures with institutional investors. From 1983 to 1995, Mr. Jacoby held a variety of senior management positions in the acquisitions, asset management and finance departments of Winthrop Financial Associates, a real estate investment company which owned and managed multiple property types. Mr. Jacoby holds a Bachelor of Arts degree from Dartmouth College and a Master of Business Administration degree from Boston University.
